verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce is a payments and commerce platform that exposes tools to agents. It is not an agent or MCP host that consumes other MCP servers' tools, so this client-side story is a category error for this product. The evidence shows only the server and provider roles: PayPal's own MCP server, an Agent Toolkit that exposes PayPal APIs to agent frameworks, and a merchant-built MCP server that ChatGPT calls in the ACP flow. Nothing shows PayPal itself plugging in third-party MCP servers.
